The Starting Hyperparameters That a Term Asks the Outer Search For

Source: R/variants.R
term_hyper_start.Rd

Returns the values at which a fitting layer starts the outer search for the hyperparameters of term, or NULL for the layer's own start. A held value is not a start and always takes precedence.

Usage

term_hyper_start(term, ...)

Arguments

term

A term.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

NULL, or a named numeric vector of starting values on the scale of the hyperparameters.

Details

The base method returns NULL. For scs() it returns the smoothing parameter that a version of term_variants() carries: a unimodal or sigmoid shape with its location given is fitted from two starts of the coefficients and two starting smoothing parameters, 1 and 0.01, because far from the mode of the data the fit from a smoothing parameter of 1 stays on the flat curve.

See also

term_variants().

Examples

term_hyper_start(s(x))
#> NULL
